exact_claim_text: An Aadhaar number holder can update their name a maximum of two times in their lifetime.
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Aadhaar number holder can update his/her Name... up to maximum of two times in life time.

exact_claim_text: Typographical or operator data-entry errors do not increment the resident's lifetime name update count (count remains 0).
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Update due to operator error -> Count remains 0. (Unmentioned in DOC_043).

exact_claim_text: Minor spelling corrections or initial expansions consume one of the resident's lifetime name updates.
paragraph_section_or_annexure: DOC_039 Annexure I Case 1 & 2 vs DOC_043 Annexure A Category 1
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Neither document explicitly confirms whether fixing a single phonetic letter decrements the lifetime quota counter.

exact_claim_text: Minor spelling corrections where names are phonetically similar (e.g. Ram to Rama) require only standard Proof of Identity (PoI).
paragraph_section_or_annexure: Annexure A, Category 1 (Minor Name Change), Scenario (d)
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Names are phonetically similar: Applicable POI required. No Gazette notification or affidavit required.

exact_claim_text: Expanding an abbreviation/initial to a full name or abbreviating a name to initials (e.g., V. S. Prasad to Vaddi Venkata Rama Siva Prasad) requires standard PoI.
paragraph_section_or_annexure: Annexure A, Category 1 (Minor Name Change), Scenario (a)
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Abbreviation to expanded name: Applicable POI in support of full name. No Gazette notification required.

exact_claim_text: Complete change of name or change of identity (e.g., Ram Kumar to Shyam Gupta) is categorized as a Major Name Change and is liable to be rejected if not accompanied by an official Gazette Notification.
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: In case such matching results in complete change in name / change of identity... the update request is liable to be rejected, if not accompanied by a Gazette Notification.

exact_claim_text: Change of surname of women post-marriage or divorce is permitted upon submission of prescribed Affidavit (Annexure D) along with supporting document (Marriage Certificate / Divorce Decree / PoI).
paragraph_section_or_annexure: Annexure A, Category 4, Scenario (b) & Annexure D
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Change of surname post marriage/divorce: Prescribed Affidavit (Annexure D) on Rs. 10 stamp paper along with Marriage Certificate/Divorce Decree or POI.

exact_claim_text: If a resident requires a 3rd or subsequent name update after exhausting their 2-update limit, the request must be processed under the Exception Handling Process through the UIDAI Regional Office.
paragraph_section_or_annexure: Section B (Name Update Procedure in Exception Handling), Sub-paras (i) & (ii)
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Resident who has exhausted name update limit may approach Regional Office through email/post or call 1947. (Workflow omitted in DOC_043).

exact_claim_text: UIDAI Regional Offices hold exclusive authority to verify exception cases and recommend packet replay to Tech Centre Bengaluru.
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Regional Office shall examine request and recommend to Tech Centre for packet replay. (Workflow omitted in DOC_043).

exact_claim_text: Gender update is permitted once in a lifetime and requires a medical certificate issued by a surgeon or a government transgender certificate.
paragraph_section_or_annexure: Section C (Gender Update), Sub-paras (ii) & (iii) & Annexure III
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Gender update is allowed only once in life time... medical certificate from qualified surgeon. (DOC_043 covers name updates only).

exact_claim_text: Supporting documents must be produced in original at the enrolment/update centre; expired documents or photocopies are strictly unacceptable.
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Original documents must be produced... photocopies/scans not acceptable... documents must be valid as on date of application. Enacted under Schedule II of Aadhaar Regulations 2016.

exact_claim_text: Residents lacking primary documentary proof can submit the Standard Certificate for Aadhaar Enrolment/Update issued by authorized certifiers, valid for strictly 3 months from date of issue.
supporting_quotation_or_source_descripti: Certificate to be used for Aadhaar Enrolment/Update... valid for 3 months from date of issue. Implements UIDAI standard format recognized under Schedule II Category 30/31.
